description: Accepts the review agreement for a verified site as the caller, and records the caller's address, the role they state, the time, and the version hash, which must be the current one. Acceptance starts the daily schedule: today's run is created and requested at once, and each later UTC day brings one run. Requires the admin role.

host.description: Host of a site from the sites tool, such as example.com

name: acceptAgreement
title: Accept the review agreement
